description: This file defines the class `FormatWithAchievement` which implements the `ValueFormatter` interface. It provides a method to format achievement values into human-readable strings, specifically 'Positive' and 'Negative', based on predefined constant values.

classes.name: FormatWithAchievement
classes.description: A formatter class that translates achievement constants into display strings ('Positive' or 'Negative') based on input values.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string ('Positive' or 'Negative') based on the input achievement value, or null if the value does not match known constants.
